scenario_meta.description: A cliffside city taxes spoken promises by their weight, and couriers carry unpaid ones between households.
scenario_meta.simulation_objective: Navigate the promise economy by making, weighing, transferring, fulfilling, concealing, or contesting obligations while balancing household trust, courier safety, public revenue, route access, and structural resonance.
player_entry_points: A red overload flag at Burden Sorting Post forces a choice between delaying legal dispatches and risking promise decay.
A household asks for representation before a third reading in Triple Reading Chamber makes its disputed tax binding.
Couriers gather at Courier Refusal Shelter to demand enforceable load caps before the next dispatch cycle.
A lien at Anchor Gate and Lift Mouth isolates households from water, work, and a redemption deadline.
creator_conflict_hooks: The Bond-Seal Refusal Captain calls a dispatch halt after seals begin humming beyond tolerance. The Bell Treasury threatens bond forfeiture, while delayed caskets increase Courier Burden Load and Civic Resonance Stability risk.

Three licensed readings condemn a household to a lift lien, but the Contradiction Reader of the Third Brass finds a chamber distortion. Reopening the assessment may reduce Promise Tax Arrears while damaging confidence in every recent ruling.
The Drain-Echo Amnesty Broker offers limited protection to expose a forged witness chain. The evidence could reduce Untaxed Promise Trade but also void agreements keeping several households solvent.

The Listening-Bolt Cooperative Rigger can reopen a closed lift only by diverting dampers from Burden Sorting Post. Reopening improves Cliff Route Access immediately, but clustered caskets may destabilize the depot.
